edition.title: Notificatio de ritu Exorcismi

passages.context: Dated 27 January 1999, the notification states that the Latin edition appeared the preceding day and could enter use. It also states that a diocesan bishop could petition the Apostolic See for a commissioned exorcist to use the hitherto-used title XII of the 1952 Roman Ritual.
passages.notes: This controls historical publication and the notification's petition route. It does not establish current authorization or a general permission to use the older book.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.
passages.rights_basis: The exact modern journal issue is publicly delivered by the responsible Holy See dicastery, but it contains modern editorial, typographic, liturgical, and scholarly material and no artifact-level redistribution license was located. Online official availability alone is not repository redistribution permission.

alternate_titles: Notification concerning the rite of Exorcism
